scenes.text: Have you ever noticed that despite millions of years of evolution, not a single mammal on Earth has green fur while birds and insects easily hit the camouflage jackpot?
The scientific secret lies in our hair, which can only produce two specific types of pigment: brown-black and red-yellow, meaning mammals lack the biology to synthesize blue to mix with yellow.
But here is the craziest part: most prey animals can't even see the color red, meaning a bright orange tiger looks green to a deer and blends perfectly into the forest.
Would you choose to have green hair if it meant you could disappear into the woods, or do you prefer standing out? Tell me in the comments and subscribe for more!
